def _check_fields_for_cls(field_out: str, field_cls_out: str) -> None: 
1237def _check_fields_for_cls(field_out: str, field_cls_out: str) -> None:
1238    """
1239    Check if the fields returned by component separation are compatible with the desired angular power spectra.
1240
1241    Parameters
1242    ----------
1243        field_out : str
1244            Fields loaded from the component separation outputs. It can be one of the following:
1245            - 'T', 'E', 'B', 'QU', 'QU_E', 'QU_B', 'TQU', 'TEB'
1246        field_cls_out : str
1247            Fields for which to compute the angular power spectra. It can be one of the following:
1248            - 'TT', 'EE', 'BB', 'TTEE', 'TTEETE', 'TTBB', 'TTBBTB', 'EEBB', 'EEBBEB', 'TTEEBB', 'TTEEBBTEEBTB'
1249    
1250    Raises
1251    ------
1252        ValueError
1253            If the fields are not compatible.
1254    """
1255    valid_fields = ['T', 'E', 'B', 'QU', 'QU_E', 'QU_B', 'EB', 'TQU', 'TEB']
1256    valid_cls_out = [
1257        'TT', 'EE', 'BB',
1258        'TE','TB', 'EB'
1259    ]
1260
1261    if field_out not in valid_fields:
1262        raise ValueError(f'Invalid field_out: "{field_out}". Must be one of {valid_fields}.')
1263    
1264    if field_out in ['T','E','B'] and (len(field_cls_out)!=1 or field_cls_out[0] != f"{field_out}{field_out}"):
1265        raise ValueError(f'If "field_out" is "{field_out}", "field_cls_out" must be "{field_out}{field_out}" or ["{field_out}{field_out}"].')
1266
1267    if field_out in ["QU", "EB"]:
1268        if any(x in ["TT", "TE", "TB"] for x in field_cls_out):
1269            raise ValueError(f'If "field_out" is "{field_out}", "field_cls_out" cannot contain "TT", "TE", or "TB".')
1270
1271    if field_out == "QU_E" and (len(field_cls_out)!=1 or field_cls_out[0] != "EE"):
1272        raise ValueError('If "field_out" is "QU_E", "field_cls_out" must be "EE" or ["EE"].')
1273    if field_out == "QU_B" and (len(field_cls_out)!=1 or field_cls_out[0] != "BB"):
1274        raise ValueError('If "field_out" is "QU_B", "field_cls_out" must be "BB" or ["BB"].')

  • field_cls_out (str): Fields for which to compute the angular power spectra. It can be one of the following:

def _load_cls( path: str, components: list, field_cls_out: str, mask_folder: str, nside: int, lmax: int, fwhm_out: float, nsim: Optional[str] = None, return_Dell: bool = False) -> numpy.ndarray: 
1276def _load_cls(path: str, components:list, field_cls_out: str, mask_folder: str,
1277    nside: int, lmax: int, fwhm_out: float, nsim: Optional[str] = None, return_Dell: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
1278    """
1279    Load angular power spectra of requested component separation outputs computed according to mask_type.
1280
1281    Parameters
1282    ----------
1283        path : str
1284            Path to the directory containing the power spectra
1285        components : list or str
1286            List of component names or a single component name for which spectra have to be loaded.
1287        field_cls_out : str
1288            The field(s) stored in the files to load.
1289        mask_folder: str
1290            Folder containing information about the masking approach used to compute angular power spectra.
1291        nside : int
1292            HEALPix resolution associated to the component separation outputs on which power spectrum has been computed.
1293        lmax : int
1294            Maximum multipole used to compute angular power spectra.
1295        fwhm_out : float
1296            Full width at half maximum of the output maps in arcminutes on which power spectrum has been computed.
1297        nsim : int or str, optional
1298            Simulation index of the compsep outputs. If None, it will look for files without nsim label. Default: None.
1299        return_Dell: bool
1300            If True, it will look for 'Dls' instead of 'Cls'. Default: False.
1301
1302    Returns
1303    -------
1304        np.ndarray
1305            Loaded computed angular power spectra for the requested component separation run and output components.
1306    
1307    """
1308    nsim = _format_nsim(nsim)
1309
1310    loaded_cls = []
1311
1312    if isinstance(components, str):
1313        components = [components]
1314    if not isinstance(components, list):
1315        raise ValueError("components must be a string or a list of strings.")
1316
1317    pre_filename = "Dls" if return_Dell else "Cls"
1318
1319    for component in components:
1320        component_name = component.split('/')[0] if '/' in component else component
1321        filename = os.path.join(
1322            path,
1323            f"spectra/{mask_folder}/{component}/{pre_filename}_{field_cls_out}_{component_name}_{fwhm_out}acm_ns{nside}_lmax{lmax}"
1324        )
1325        if nsim is not None:
1326            filename += f"_{nsim}.fits"
1327        loaded_cls.append(hp.read_cl(filename))
1328
1329    return np.array(loaded_cls)

class BBin: 
1331class BBin:
1332    """Class for binning power spectra into bands of ell values."""
1333
1334    def __init__(self, ell_bins, lmax, is_Dell=False, w_ell=None):
1335        """
1336        ell_bins : list of arrays
1337            Each element contains the ell values in that band.
1338        is_Dell : bool
1339            If True, bin Dell instead of Cl.
1340        """
1341        self.ell_bins = ell_bins
1342        self.n_bands = len(ell_bins)
1343        self.lmax = lmax
1344        self.is_Dell = is_Dell
1345        if w_ell is not None:
1346            self.w_ell = w_ell
1347        else:
1348            self.w_ell = np.ones(lmax + 1)
1349
1350    # --------------------------
1351    # Constructors
1352    # --------------------------
1353
1354    @classmethod
1355    def from_edges(bin_class, ell_ini, ell_end, is_Dell=False):
1356        """
1357        Create bins from lower/upper edges.
1358        
1359        ell_ini, ell_end : arrays of same length
1360            Each pair defines one band: ell_ini[i] <= ell < ell_end[i]
1361        """
1362        ell_bins = []
1363        for lo, hi in zip(ell_ini, ell_end):
1364            ell_bins.append(np.arange(lo, hi))
1365        return bin_class(ell_bins, lmax=ell_end[-1]-1, is_Dell=is_Dell)
1366
1367    @classmethod
1368    def from_lmax_linear(bin_class, lmax, nlb, is_Dell=False):
1369        """
1370        Create linear bins of width nlb up to lmax.
1371        
1372        lmax : int
1373        nlb  : bin width (delta_ell)
1374        """
1375        ell_bins = []
1376        for lo in range(2, lmax + 1, nlb):
1377            hi = min(lo + nlb - 1, lmax)
1378            ell_bins.append(np.arange(lo, hi + 1))
1379        return bin_class(ell_bins, lmax=lmax, is_Dell=is_Dell)

1385    def bin_cell(self, cl):
1386        """
1387        Bin power spectra.
1388
1389        Accepts:
1390        - cl shape (lmax+1,)
1391        - cl shape (n_fields, lmax+1)
1392
1393        Returns:
1394        - if input was 1D: shape (n_bands,)
1395        - if input was 2D: shape (n_fields, n_bands)
1396        """
1397        cl = np.asarray(cl)
1398
1399        was_1d = (cl.ndim == 1)
1400        if was_1d:
1401            cl = cl[None, :]  # -> (1, lmax+1)
1402        elif cl.ndim != 2:
1403            raise ValueError(f"cl must be 1D or 2D, got shape {cl.shape}")
1404
1405        n_fields, lmax_plus_1 = cl.shape
1406        cl_binned = np.zeros((n_fields, self.n_bands), dtype=cl.dtype)
1407
1408        for ib, ell_vals in enumerate(self.ell_bins):
1409            ell_vals = np.asarray(ell_vals)
1410            ell_vals = ell_vals[ell_vals < lmax_plus_1]  # safety
1411
1412            if ell_vals.size == 0:
1413                continue
1414
1415            if self.is_Dell:
1416                factor = ell_vals * (ell_vals + 1) / (2.0 * np.pi)  # (n_ell,)
1417                band_values = cl[:, ell_vals] * factor[None, :]     # broadcast
1418            else:
1419                band_values = cl[:, ell_vals]
1420
1421            cl_binned[:, ib] = np.sum(band_values * self.w_ell[ell_vals][None, :], axis=1) / np.sum(self.w_ell[ell_vals])
1422
1423        return cl_binned[0] if was_1d else cl_binned

1426        """

1432        effective_ells = np.zeros(self.n_bands)

1434            ell_vals = np.asarray(ell_vals)
1435            effective_ells[ib] = np.sum(ell_vals * self.w_ell[ell_vals]) / np.sum(self.w_ell[ell_vals])
1436        return effective_ells

1355    def from_edges(bin_class, ell_ini, ell_end, is_Dell=False):
1356        """
1357        Create bins from lower/upper edges.
1358        
1359        ell_ini, ell_end : arrays of same length
1360            Each pair defines one band: ell_ini[i] <= ell < ell_end[i]
1361        """
1362        ell_bins = []
1363        for lo, hi in zip(ell_ini, ell_end):
1364            ell_bins.append(np.arange(lo, hi))
1365        return bin_class(ell_bins, lmax=ell_end[-1]-1, is_Dell=is_Dell)
